purpose: Evidence that the four masterplan-v2 plan gates are wired into the single required oya-ci-required context, run in CI on every PR against dev, are green on the reconciled candidate state, and are blocking: a red run demonstrably blocks the probe PR and a green run admits the consolidation PR.
claim_ceiling: CI-wiring and blocking-behavior evidence only. No completion, readiness, or production claim for the consolidation effort as a whole; work-item statuses remain governed by /specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2 evidence rules.

gates_under_evidence.checks: work-item ID-space uniqueness, dependency-DAG acyclicity and direction contract, dangling/orphan reference detection over /specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2
byte re-derivation of every masterplan projection (docs/MASTERPLAN.md, fabric-loop cards, flow-metrics ledger, declared generated faces) from masterplan_v2; any byte drift or hand edit fails closed

every verified-completion status claim and evidence-attached hermes done-card import cross-checked against recorded completion evidence; dangling evidence pointers, retired-surface refs, and malformed refs fail closed

read-surface resurrection sweep (archived/absorbed plan surfaces keep their archive markers; superseded authorities cannot be revived) plus exact-set entry-surface equality against /specs/root-hub-pointers.json

ci_wiring.matrix_leg: gate · cross-artifact-agreement (GATE-1, incl. the 4 masterplan-v2 plan gates: structural ID/DAG/orphans · projection-freshness · plan-vs-evidence · read-contract/entry-surface)
ci_wiring.fan_in: oya-ci-required job (zero-build fan-in; green IFF every constituent gate lane is green; the gate matrix is a needs: dependency, so a red masterplan leg forces the fan-in RED)
ci_wiring.config_registration: oya-ci.toml [[gates.enabled]] id = cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement (face cross_artifact); gate_registration meta-test in the cloud-ci-firewall lane enforces every in-tree gate crate is a fan-in dependency
ci_wiring.triggers: pull_request against dev (opened/reopened/synchronize/edited/ready_for_review), push to dev, merge_group, workflow_dispatch
ci_wiring.secondary_enforcement: the buck2 hermetic lane (buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/...) runs the same gate tests, so the four plan gates bind through two independent required lanes of the same context

branch_protection.note: oya-ci-required is the SINGLE required context (ADR-0515 one-canonical-CI); no other status check gates merges to dev

organic_drift_catch.summary: Beyond the synthetic probe, the plan-vs-evidence gate caught REAL drift during this wiring effort: dev PR #1167 (commit 4c1971da2) retired evidence/multispectrum/t_08468865-data-005-openslo-review-fix-1782953110.json after the consolidation branch diverged; the PR merge-candidate tree therefore dropped a file still cited by three hermes done-card imports (rows for t_08468865, t_9f6bfb4e, t_f2327289).
organic_drift_catch.remediation: branch synchronized with dev (merge) and the hermes ledger re-derived by its single writer tools/oya-masterplan-hermes-forensic-ledger-app against a fresh pinned board snapshot (sha256 51379d8c6d48c0577baf8aa6eac4522f3d01042fec3475f0e56ed6be8b642b38): the retired attachment mechanically dropped (evidence_attached 37 -> 34), no hand edits
organic_drift_catch.significance: demonstrates the anti-staleness property the gate exists for — plan-vs-evidence drift is detected mechanically on the merge candidate, never by discipline

green_run_admitting.recording_protocol: this field is filled by the immediately following commit once the oya-ci-required run on the reconciled head completes green; the run id cannot be known at authoring time because the run executes on the commit that carries this packet
